#### 1. autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis 2  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.438)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-2142712)

**Proposed mechanism:** ALOX12B (HGNC:446) —DISRUPTS→ arachidonic acid metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-1936793); ALOXE3 (HGNC:445) —DISRUPTS→ arachidonic acid metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-1936793); arachidonic acid metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-1936793) —LEADS_TO→ cornification pathway (REACT:R-HSA-168970); cornification pathway (REACT:R-HSA-168970) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital ichthyosis (HP:0001054); cornification pathway (REACT:R-HSA-168970) —LEADS_TO→ Dry skin (HP:0000952); cornification pathway (REACT:R-HSA-168970) —LEADS_TO→ Scaling skin (HP:0000954). **Why it matters:** Understanding the shared molecular pathways disrupted in these ichthyosis subtypes can facilitate the development of targeted therapies aimed at restoring lipid metabolism and epidermal barrier function, potentially benefiting patients with either disease.
